_readme: Colour code: [[r:...]] RED = best guess, unconfirmed. [[c:...]] CYAN = new or unknown, suggested by Claude for approval. Plain = confirmed by owner.
name: St Mary's church

layers.essential_history: [[r:St Mary's church was built mostly between about 1180 and 1290. Sources differ slightly on the exact dates.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Deeper history for this stop is still to be written.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Journal page: the church bell marks the hours in this story. When a witness says a bell, listen carefully.]]

puzzle.title: The restoration plaque
puzzle.intro: [[r:Go to the rear of the church and find the plaque about the restoration grant. Stay on the public path.]]
puzzle.question: [[r:What was the restoration grant amount, in pounds? (numbers only)]]
hints: [[r:Look at the back (rear) of the church for a small plaque.]]
[[r:The plaque mentions a grant for restoration.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[r:If you cannot reach the plaque, look at the photo of it if one is shown, or ask for the answer.]]

directions_to_next: [[c:Directions to be supplied after the recce. Next stop: Taylor's Green.]]
notes: The year on the plaque is worn and unconfirmed. Do not ask for it.
